title: Interview Question - Salary Range
description:
Here's how to answer this common interview question

This one is all about salary range. 

Because not every job description lists the salary range unfortunately.

You never want to say the number first, so try this in your next salary negotiation if the recruiter pushes for an answer. 

#interviewtips #jobinterview #interviewprep #interviewquestion
transcript: what's your ideal salary range I'm open to discussing compensation and want to ensure we're align could you share the range you've budgeted for this role that will help me gauge how my experiences you know fit within your expectations we'd really love to hear a number from you if you could share I'm flexible and happy discuss once I have a better understanding of your expectations and the responsibilities of the role
